In today’s episode of The Daily Brief, we take a deep dive into one key story and cover another story shaping Indian and global markets:
1. Did 50 Crore Indians Really Escape Poverty?
The World Bank estimates that nearly 50 crore Indians escaped poverty between 2011–12 and 2023–24. But economists disagree on how much of this decline reflects real progress and how much stems from changes in how poverty is measured.
